strategy_roster.name: Supertrend Rsi
strategy_roster.notes: The Supertrend line is rebuilt as the 10-bar high minus 3x ATR(14) from the documented SupertrendPeriod=10 and Multiplier=3.0, with RSI(14)<30 and the flip exit as documented. The Supertrend trailing stop is an indicator line rather than a percentage stop and the 5-minute candle type is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: TP SL Trailing
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state the strategy generates no entries and only installs/trails protective stop and take-profit on existing positions, so no single-symbol market signal exists and the never-true negative-price guard is used. Pip distances, trailing step, and the OnlyZeroValues flag are order-management fields.

strategy_roster.name: Entry Fragger
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) < 0 and roc(close,2) < 0 and close > ema(close,50) + std(close,50) / 4
strategy_roster.notes: Two consecutive down closes (redCount>=2 with the documented accuracy of 2) below EMA(50) followed by a green bar closing above EMA(50)+stdev/4. The stdev window is an explicit fallback, the short leg and reverse flag are omitted, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Max Pain
strategy_roster.notes: Volume above its LookbackPeriod=70 average and a price change above 0.029 (2.9% in the documented percent form). The VIX filter has no price-series equivalent, the 8-bar HoldPeriods exit is approximated by a momentum reversal, and the 2.4x volatility stop is not a fixed percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Lexical Density Filings
strategy_roster.notes: The factor is computed from regulatory-filing text (lexical density) and a cross-sectional quintile sort with a February/May/August/November rebalance, so no single-symbol market-derived entry exists and the impossible guard is used. The docs also state no stop-losses are used.

strategy_roster.name: Slow Stochastic Mode
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is unavailable, so %K(5) is written division-free as 2*(smoothed close - low)/(high - low) with Slowing=3 applied to the close and the documented Breakdown 50-level cross. The Twist default mode, Jurik-style phase, SignalBar offset and 1000/2000-point stops cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: Awesome Oscillator Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((high + low) / 2,5) - sma((high + low) / 2,34) < 0 and (sma((high + low) / 2,5) - sma((high + low) / 2,34)) - sma(sma((high + low) / 2,5) - sma((high + low) / 2,34),5) > 0 and (bb_upper(close,20) - bb_lower(close,20)) < sma(bb_upper(close,20) - bb_lower(close,20),50)
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma((high + low) / 2,5) > sma((high + low) / 2,34) and (sma((high + low) / 2,5) - sma((high + low) / 2,34)) - sma(sma((high + low) / 2,5) - sma((high + low) / 2,34),5) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: Awesome Oscillator 5/34 on median price with its histogram, requiring the histogram to flip up while the AO is still negative inside a Bollinger-width squeeze. The four-bar pattern count, stochastic oversold cross, ATR(3) stop/target, trailing and the profit filter are not expressible; no percentage values are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Charles EMA RSI
strategy_roster.notes: Fast EMA(18) crossing above slow EMA(60) with RSI(14)>55, all documented. The 0.008 stop and 0.02 target are StockSharp fractions, entered as 0.8%/2.0%; TrailStart/TrailOffset trailing (0.006/0.003) has no DSL field.

strategy_roster.name: Kalman Filter Trend
strategy_roster.notes: A Kalman filter is not available, so its estimate is proxied by a smooth EMA(20) with the documented enter-above/exit-below relationship; the 20-bar length is an explicit fallback. The 0.01/0.1 process and measurement noise and the ATR stop are not expressible as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Trigger Line
strategy_roster.notes: The weighted trend line and least-squares MA are not in the DSL, so a short SMA(10) is crossed with a longer EMA(40) standing in for LSMA; both lengths are explicit fallbacks because only parameter names are documented. The short leg mirrors the same cross.
